shots.caption: Eight pumps: ram extended, ambulance lifted, cooler released
shots.pre: T.runDevCommand('site convoy'); await wait(150); T.doAction(); const D=T.convoyDbg; for (let i=0;i<8;i++){D.step(D.state().untilBeat);T.doAction();} await wait(100); T.player.position.set(-122,T.sampleHeight(-122,54),54);
